German translation

notes.title: Update 0.8.4
notes.notes: Aside from the usual improvements, this update contains a preview of skins. For certain cars, the game will randomly select a skin at round start. It will not work like this in the final game.

notes.title: Update 0.8.1
notes.notes: This is a smaller one. You can now enjoy the game with even lower graphics settings. Also, I have added a map select option to the menu.

notes.title: Update 0.8.0
notes.notes: Another car is joining Geared for Fear. It features new game mechanics - overheating and ricochet bullets.

notes.title: Update 0.7.1
notes.notes: This update serves to test a small rework to ammo. In this new version, ammo refills at triple speed while standing still.

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Update 0.6.0 delivers a new map. The image below compares this map (right) to what came before (left).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945109/12610465de539cf8fc566eb6d1d8f7ac5fbf18bc.png
The update also improves performance and adds a new graphics option: screen-space reflections. The setting is turned off by default, because weaker graphics cards will struggle with it.

Originally, the plan was to release Geared for Fear in Early Access this year. Instead, the ongoing free alpha will continue into next year. There is no planned end date for the alpha, but at minimum, it will last for three more months.

notes.title: Update 0.5.0
notes.notes: The playtest now features one more vehicle. Gameplay-wise, it should be fully-functional, though the muzzle flash has a tendency to not show up. The update also contains performance optimizations.

notes.title: Update 0.4.2
notes.notes: This update is should drastically improve performance. There are also some fixes, but no new content. Update 0.5.0 will add a new vehicle, coming in August.
